items.docs: Gets the details for a specific package, including name, aliases, duration, and terms. Use this endpoint to understand a package’s alias schedule, or display a specific package’s details to end customers.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of results that should be returned

params.name: next_page
params.description: Cursor that indicates where the next page of results should start.

items.docs: Lists all packages with details including name, aliases, duration, and terms. To view contracts on a specific package, use the `listContractsOnPackage` endpoint.

Archive a package. Archived packages cannot be used to create new contracts. However, existing contracts associated with the package will continue to function as normal. Once you archive a package, you can still retrieve it in the UI and API, but you cannot unarchive it.
